axis: a plea that concedes the fault it covers → a justification that clears the act outright

members.tone: Admits the fault while covering it - what is being defended is already offensive behaviour or a promise broken, whereas *defence* presumes nothing against the act at all.
The formal written case made for a conviction held strongly - the most deliberate and constructed member here, and argument in support rather than regret.
The plain word for the justification of an act or belief, passing no verdict on whether it succeeds and presuming no wrongdoing the way *excuse* does.
Carries the outcome inside it - the act or belief comes out justified, where *defence* only puts the case.
